exports.description: A fixed-length view of binary data, backed by an `ArrayBuffer` and extending `Uint8Array`.

members.name: Buffer
signatures: new Buffer(arrayBuffer: ArrayBuffer, offset?: number, length?: number)
members.description: Create a `Buffer` viewing `arrayBuffer`, optionally starting at `offset` for `length` bytes.

params.name: arrayBuffer
params.description: - The `ArrayBuffer` to view.

params.name: offset
params.description: - Byte offset into `arrayBuffer` to start the view at; defaults to `0`.

params.name: length
params.description: - Number of bytes to view from `offset`; defaults to the rest of `arrayBuffer`.

throws.condition: thrown if the resulting length would exceed `Buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`.

members.name: Buffer.alloc
signatures: Buffer.alloc(size: number, fill: string, encoding?: BufferEncoding): Buffer
Buffer.alloc(size: number, fill?: Buffer | number | boolean): Buffer
members.description: Allocate a new, zero-filled `Buffer` of `size` bytes, optionally filled with `fill`.

params.name: size
params.description: - Number of bytes to allocate.

params.name: fill
params.description: - Value to fill the buffer with — a string, `Buffer`, number byte, or boolean.

params.name: encoding
params.description: - Encoding used to interpret `fill` when it's a string; defaults to `'utf8'`.

throws.condition: thrown if `size` exceeds `Buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`.

members.name: Buffer.allocUnsafe
members.description: Allocate a new `Buffer` of `size` bytes without zeroing its contents first.

params.name: size
params.description: - Number of bytes to allocate.

throws.condition: thrown if `size` exceeds `Buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`.

members.name: Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow
members.description: Allocate a new `Buffer` of `size` bytes without zeroing its contents first, bypassing the internal buffer pool.

params.name: size
params.description: - Number of bytes to allocate.

throws.condition: thrown if `size` exceeds `Buffer.constants.MAX_LENGTH`.

members.name: Buffer.atob
members.description: Decode a base64-encoded string into a Latin-1 binary string.

params.name: data
params.description: - The base64-encoded string to decode.

members.name: Buffer.btoa
members.description: Encode a Latin-1 binary string into a base64 string.

params.name: data
params.description: - The value to encode; non-strings are coerced with `String()`.

members.name: Buffer.BufferEncoding
members.description: The set of encodings supported by `Buffer` methods that convert between bytes and strings.

members.name: Buffer.byteLength
signatures: Buffer.byteLength(string: ArrayBufferView | ArrayBufferLike | string, encoding?: BufferEncoding): number
members.description: Return the number of bytes `string` would occupy once encoded as `encoding`.

params.name: string
params.description: - The value whose encoded length to measure — a string, or an `ArrayBufferView`/`ArrayBufferLike` (whose own `byteLength` is returned unchanged).

params.name: encoding
params.description: - Encoding used to measure `string` when it's a string; defaults to `'utf8'`.

throws.condition: thrown if the encoding is not a recognized `BufferEncoding`.

members.name: Buffer.coerce
members.description: Return `buffer` unchanged if it is already a `Buffer`, otherwise wrap its underlying `ArrayBuffer` in a new `Buffer`.

params.name: buffer
params.description: - The value to coerce into a `Buffer`.

members.name: Buffer.concat
members.description: Concatenate `buffers` into a single new `Buffer`, optionally truncated or zero-padded to `length`.

params.name: buffers
params.description: - The buffers to concatenate, in order.

params.name: length
params.description: - Total byte length of the result; defaults to the sum of `buffers`' lengths.

members.name: Buffer.constants
members.description: Limits for buffers and strings: `MAX_LENGTH` (largest possible `Buffer`) and `MAX_STRING_LENGTH` (largest possible string).

members.name: Buffer.copyBytesFrom
signatures: Buffer.copyBytesFrom(view: ArrayBufferLike, offset?: number, length?: number): Buffer
members.description: Copy the bytes of `view`, starting at `offset` for `length` elements, into a new `Buffer`.

params.name: view
params.description: - The typed array (or other `ArrayBufferLike` view) to copy bytes from.

params.name: offset
params.description: - Index of the first element to copy; defaults to `0`.

params.name: length
params.description: - Number of elements to copy; defaults to the rest of `view`.

throws.condition: thrown if `offset + length` exceeds `view.length`.

params.name: data
params.description: - The array, array-like, string, buffer, or `ArrayBuffer` to create a new `Buffer` from.

members.name: compare
signatures: compare(target: Buffer, targetStart?: number, targetEnd?: number, sourceStart?: number, sourceEnd?: number): number
members.description: Compare two buffers' contents lexicographically, returning -1, 0, or 1 for sort ordering.

params.name: target
params.description: - The buffer to compare against.

params.name: targetStart
params.description: - Offset within `target` to start comparing from; defaults to `0`.

params.name: targetEnd
params.description: - Offset within `target` (exclusive) to stop comparing at; defaults to `target.byteLength`.

params.name: sourceStart
params.description: - Offset within this buffer to start comparing from; defaults to `0`.

params.name: sourceEnd
params.description: - Offset within this buffer (exclusive) to stop comparing at; defaults to `this.byteLength`.

params.name: targetStart
params.description: - Offset within `target` to start writing at; defaults to `0`.

params.name: sourceStart

params.name: sourceEnd
params.description: - Offset within this buffer (exclusive) to stop copying at; defaults to `this.byteLength`.

params.description: - The buffer to compare this buffer's contents against.
